lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows along the mid-to-upper flank posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance crossing the horizontal rows, with high-intensity blobs centered at the intersection points of this grid-like structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary linear features running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, marked by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition (light upper, shadowed lower).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs scattered across the posterior two-thirds of the first dorsal fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, dark pixel formations situated ventrally to the main body mass, exhibiting characteristics of attached or trailing commensal organisms.
